title: UI Branch Status
description: Computed: a branch's chain to its root, its changed items and conflicts the requesting user may read, the URL of a type's list on it, what the user may do with it (write, publish, pull, push), its pushes and versions the user may read, and the studio's endpoints. Read-only.

branch.description: The branch, as its URL names it (a name, optionally @pinned).

chain.description: The branch, then its ancestors, nearest first.

prefix.description: A published branch's prefix; null for a working branch.

changed.description: The branch's own rows (overrides, additions, deletion markers) the user may read; none on main.

conflicts.description: The conflicts on own rows the user may read: those a pull listed (parent), then those with a packaged layer (layer).

browse_url.description: With ?type=<slug>: that type's list on the branch, under its published root's prefix; else null.

may_write.description: The branch is a working branch and the user may PUT it.

may_publish.description: The user may PUT UI branches in the context "": set, change or remove a prefix.

pushes.description: The latest 20 pushes (restores included) with the branch as source or target that the user may GET, newest first.

versions.description: The branch's latest 20 versions the user may GET, newest first.

restore.description: The POST of a restore push of the version into the branch (source null, state applied, in the branch's context), when the user may POST it; published branches included.

actions.description: What the studio may send to change the branch; on a published branch, no pull and no promote targets.

pull.description: The PUT of the branch's content with pull: true and its ETag; when it has a parent and may_write.

promote.description: One entry per ancestor in chain, nearest first.

apply.description: The POST of a push into target in the state applied, when the user may POST it.

propose.description: The POST of a push into target in the state proposed, when the user may POST it.

endpoints.description: The studio's endpoints (paths, not under the API); sample, explain and options are templates in which {slug} stands for a type's slug. null when the studio's URLs are not included.

action.description: What a studio control sends unchanged (an R3 fixed-body element): body as JSON with method to href, with etag as If-Match. null when it is not offered.

href.description: An API path (a component maps it with in_mount).

body.description: The JSON body, sent as it is.

etag.description: The If-Match to send, quoted; null for none.
